It can be found that NiAl-32Cr-6Mo alloy is only composed of NiAl phase and Cr phase
the primary dendrite in the alloy is also Cr(Mo) phase, while the black and gray lamellae are the NiAl phase and Cr(Mo) phase, respectively.
A new phase of Ni 2AlTi is formed in the NiAl-32Cr-6Mo-1Ti and NiAl-32Cr-6Mo-3Ti alloys.
A new phase of Ni 2AlTi is formed in the NiAl-32Cr-6Mo-1Ti and NiAl-32Cr-6Mo-3Ti alloys.

the number of precipitated Ni 2AlTi phases increases at the cell boundary. At the same time, the precipitates of Ni 2AlTi are dispersed, which improves the uniformity of microstructure at the cell boundary.
In the NiAl-32Cr-6Mo alloy, coarse primary dendrites and irregular cells are observed.
the cells are composed of alternately arranged two-phase lamellae. Obviously, the lamellae at the cell center are ﬁner than those at the cell boundary.

the eutectic cell is chrysanthemum-like, and the lamellar morphology of the microstructure is no longer maintained. Only irregular and curving pieces of the Cr(Mo) phase are scattered in the NiAl matrix.
With the increasing Ti content, the number of primary phase further becomes more, and most of them change from petal shape to dispersed block shape.
Generally speaking, the heat-treated alloy obviously shows a trend of microstructure reﬁnement compared with the as-cast alloy.
the Cr(Mo) phase at the cell core becomes lamellar, and the volume fraction of NiAl þ Cr(Mo) eutectic increases.

The Vickers hardness of alloys was tested by a 2100B Vickers hardness tester with a load of 100 g and a holding time of 10 s. Thirty locations were tested in each specimen and the average value was adopted.
As the Ti content increases, the hardness value also increases. Especially, the hardness of NiAl-32Cr-6Mo-1Ti alloy has the highest value of 575.2HV.

When the Ti content increases to 3 at.%, the hardness value is about 532 HV in the as-cast alloy, which was mainly because too much Ti element would lead to the increasing number of primary phase Cr(Mo) in the alloy

The room temperature yield strength and compression strain of NiAl-32Cr-6Mo alloy are 1093 MPa and 18.7%, respectively.
After adding 1 at.% Ti, the yield strength of as-cast NiAl-32Cr-6Mo-1Ti alloy sharply increases to 1417 MPa, which was obviously superior to other NiAl-Cr-Mo based alloys.
When 3 at.% Ti was added, the yield strength is about 1314 MPa.

the compression strength of the NiAl-32Cr-6Mo hypereutectic alloy is signiﬁcantly improved to 325.44 MPa due to the larger volume fraction of Cr(Mo) strengthening phase.

Through adding 1% Ti, the ultimate compression strength of as-cast NiAl-32Cr-6Mo-1Ti alloy increases to 408.41 MPa, demonstrating the obvious effectiveness of the Ni 2AlTi phase in improving the high-temperature strength.
However, when 3% Ti was added, the compression strength decreases to about 285.02 MPa.
